insurance_company.description: Full legal name of the issuing insurer or underwriter shown in the header. Do not return the insured, policyholder, broker, agent, payment recipient, or customer.name.

name.description: The insured or policyholder name from the labelled customer block. Never return the issuing insurer.

address.description: All address lines belonging to the same insured or policyholder block, combined into one string. Never return the issuing insurer's header address.

customer.description: One labelled insured, policyholder, customer, or Bill To identity block. Keep its name and address together and do not use the issuing insurer header.

start_date.description: The date printed beside FROM inside this same Period of Insurance block. Transcribe it exactly as printed; never use Date of Issue.

end_date.description: The date printed beside TO inside this same Period of Insurance block. Transcribe it exactly as printed and preserve its printed year.

coverage_period.description: The single visibly labelled Period of Insurance date-range block. Return start_date and end_date together from its FROM and TO rows; never use Date of Issue, invoice date, document date, payment date, or due date.

total_premium.description: Final Total Premium as a JSON number without currency codes, symbols, separators, or masking asterisks. Do not select gross premium, tax, or a line amount. If and only if the insurer is Liberty Insurance Pte Ltd and the printed value has leading asterisks after its currency code, remove only those asterisks before parsing; SGD ********100.00 must return 100.

policy_number.description: Main Policy No. or certificate number. Preserve all visible letters, digits, spaces, slashes, hyphens, and leading zeros. Do not use a document, invoice, debit-note, reference, endorsement, previous-policy, or account number.

note_type.description: From the document-level invoice or note heading, return exactly debit for Debit Note or exactly credit for Credit Note. Never return a line-item table heading such as Description of Goods or Services.
